title: Android crash report with error: `FORTIFY: pthread_mutex_lock called on a destroyed mutex` (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.5.stable
- Reproducible in https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/releases/tag/4.5.1.stable%2Bvulkan_mobile_fixes which is 4.5.1.stable + cherry-picks of Vulkan Mobile fixes made by @blueskythlikesclouds recently (https://github.com/akien-mga/godot/compare/4.5.1-stable...4.5.1.stable+vulkan_mobile_fixes).
- Can't easily test 4.6.rc as this is from Google Play analytics on a game in production with thousands of users, will test 4.5.2.rc1 once it's out

### System information

Various Android devices with different SoCs/GPUs and versions (11, 13, 14, 16 Beta seen in reports)

### Issue description

This is a crash seen in the wild on a number of devices with @Draknek's [Spooky Express](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=express.spooky) (10k+ install base).

The Google Play Console reports this overarching error:
```
FORTIFY: pthread_mutex_lock called on a destroyed mutex (0x<sanitized>)
```

And this crash stack trace:
```
*** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** ***
pid: 0, tid: 21238 >>> express.spooky <<<

backtrace:

  #04  pc 0x00000000000db574  /data/app/~~Vhgpa6OywDhA90Sb-F_JJg==/express.spooky-Z_6yR7zxaAMJl1OtSLUdXQ==/split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libc++_shared.so (std::__ndk1::mutex::lock()+96) (BuildId: 725db191d65be59dc18ddb3238f9e749442844a4)
  #05  pc 0x0000000003efde20  /data/app/~~Vhgpa6OywDhA90Sb-F_JJg==/express.spooky-Z_6yR7zxaAMJl1OtSLUdXQ==/split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so (RefCounted::unreference()+41) (BuildId: a9b34d498052473c)
  #06  pc 0x000000000124678c  /data/app/~~Vhgpa6OywDhA90Sb-F_JJg==/express.spooky-Z_6yR7zxaAMJl1OtSLUdXQ==/split_config.arm64_v8a.apk!libgodot_android.so (MethodBindTR<bool>::ptrcall(Object*, void const**, void*) const+254) (BuildId: a9b34d498052473c)
  #07  pc 0x00000000000d2a64  /data/app/~~Vhgpa6OywDhA90Sb-F_JJg==/express.spooky-Z_6yR7zxaAMJl1OtSLUdXQ==/split_config.arm64_v8a.apk
```

<details>

    std::__ndk1::unique_lock<std::__ndk1::mutex>::unique_lock[abi:nn190000](std::__ndk1::mutex&)
    /root/sdk/ndk/28.1.13356709/toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/linux-x86_64/bin/../sysroot/usr/include/c++/v1/__mutex/unique_lock.h:41:11
    MutexLock<MutexImpl<std::__ndk1::mutex>>::MutexLock(MutexImpl<std::__ndk1::mutex> const&)

    /root/godot/./core/variant/binder_common.h:502:2

</details>

That's not much to go on, and I don't have an MRP.

Spooky Express uses GDScript, but also one GDExtension [fmod-gdextension](https://github.com/utopia-rise/fmod-gdextension), so it's possible that this bug is caused by the extension doing something illegal or a godot-cpp bug. But there's no _obvious_ indication of that in the stack trace.

I'm logging this so we're aware of the issue, and to see if others run into similar crashes and can provide information.
